notes.title: Women's Day Steam Event - Watch our Live Stream!
notes.content:
[h3]We're thrilled to join the Women's Day Event on Steam, which runs from March 7 - 11, 2022 and celebrates all the talented women in the games industry![/h3]

Tune in on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/262470/Rollers_of_the_Realm/]Steam[/url] to get a sneak peek of the next instalment from the Rollers of the Realm Franchise, [b]Rollers of the Realm: Reunion[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7086480/07bed705eb3eaa2b045f7163f1d418aff8aaef30.jpg[/img]
[b]
About the Game: [/b]
Flip, dash, bounce and battle through this Pinball RPG starring five cheeky pinball heroes with unique stats, physics and upgrades. Battle ancient enemies pinball style and hot swap your heroes to strategically use their abilities. Platform and sneak through medieval cities and underground labyrinths.

There are many exciting enhancements in Rollers of the Realm: Reunion that we cannot wait to share with you! If you haven't already wishlisted Rollers of the Realm: Reunion, you can do so [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1628120/Rollers_of_the_Realm_Reunion/]here[/url]. 

[previewyoutube=sX8scrDvs1o;full][/previewyoutube]

If you didn't get a chance to play the original Rollers of the Realm, it will be on sale throughout the Women's Day Steam Event or you can test out the free demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/262470/Rollers_of_the_Realm/]here[/url].

notes.title: Good Vibrations Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7086480/6f2d6f1fc57735030844e0bd4238857d6189e360.png[/img]
[h1]Feel jittery no more![/h1]

Our latest "Rollers" update fixes a long-standing vibration "always on" issue and fixes a rare "black screen" issue related to window-focus.

We added a vibration toggle to the options menu -- look for the controller icon and you can disable or enable vibration there. Default is enabled.

Thanks everyone for continuing to play "Rollers of The Realm!"

notes.title: New Sale, New Trailer
notes.content:
Hey all,

It’s been a while since you’ve heard from us! We’re popping in from the far reaches of The Realm with some exciting news!

[h1]Indie Megabooth Sale[/h1]
Rollers of the Realm is now [b]50% off[/b] as part of the Indie Megabooth Steam sale, running until May 12th! 

[h1]Remastered Trailer[/h1]
Now playing on our [b]store homepage[/b]: a remastered trailer for Rollers of the Realm. We've included a wider range of exciting moments from the game to better show off our "Very Positive" rating! Thanks to everyone who gave us a positive review!

All of us at Phantom Compass hope you are staying safe and well during these crazy times. We know being stuck at home is starting to get a little old... The IMB sale is a great opportunity to pick up Rollers, or some other awesome indie games at a discounted price to occupy some of your time stuck indoors! :) 

Well, that’s all from us! Thanks for your support. We’re signing off now! 

[i]the Phantom Compass Team[/i]

notes.title: New Patch Now Available: Casual Mode and More!
notes.content:
Are you tired of ball puns yet?  We aren't!  Rollers of the Realm has rolled out another patch for you guys!  Challenge the path paved with difficulties or try out the new casual mode in Rollers of the Realm!

Here's the full patch notes!

•      Choose the way you like to play -- new difficulty settings to please casual and hardcore players are now in the options menu
•         Color-blind friendly improvements for health bars
•         Reduced mana cost for special abilities -- feel extra awesome by using your hero’s special abilities early and often
•         Reduced the price for Hirelings -- grow your party for less gold
•         XP bonus on Arena boards
•         Minor controller navigation fixes

Try it out and let us know what you think!

notes.title: We made a patch!
notes.content:
Hello Rollers (that's you!), 

Thanks so much for reaching out to us with your issues over the past few days. Phantom Compass has been listening and we're happy to bring you our first patch. 

Patch 1.1 is a very minor patch to resolve recent control issues. 

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Improved controller support 
[*]Ability to bind the following keyboard keys: Left Shft, Right Shift, Left Ctrl, Right Ctrl, Left Alt, Right Alt. 
[/list]

Please continue to let us know the issues you're having - we're here and listening to you. 

You can follow along with this patch and issues in our community forum: http://steamcommunity.com/app/262470/discussions/0/617320167997455946/
